# wallix.bastion.externalauth_saml

Manage SAML external authentications on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a SAML identity provider used as external authentication on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml` Terraform resource.
- The service provider details of the Bastion (`sp_metadata`, `sp_entity_id`, ...) to declare on the identity provider are returned in [`externalauth`](#return-externalauth).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-authentication-name"></a>**authentication_name** | `str` / required | Name of the external authentication. Identifies it on the Bastion.<br>External authentications of every type share the same names. The module fails if an external authentication of another type already has this name. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-certificate"></a>**certificate** | `str` | PEM certificate the Bastion signs its SAML requests with, with [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key). Use `""` to remove it.<br>The Bastion only returns the subject of the certificate, so only whether it is set is compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-claim-customization"></a>**claim_customization** | `dict` | Names of the SAML attributes holding the user properties.<br>Required when the external authentication does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state).<br>When set, replaces the whole mapping, suboptions left unset are removed. |
| <a id="parameter-claim-customization-displayname"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **displayname** | `str` | Attribute holding the display name. |
| <a id="parameter-claim-customization-email"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **email** | `str` | Attribute holding the email address. |
| <a id="parameter-claim-customization-group"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **group** | `str` | Attribute holding the groups. |
| <a id="parameter-claim-customization-language"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **language** | `str` | Attribute holding the preferred language. |
| <a id="parameter-claim-customization-username"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **username** | `str` / required | Attribute holding the user name. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the external authentication. |
| <a id="parameter-idp-metadata"></a>**idp_metadata** | `str` | XML metadata of the identity provider. It must contain the signing certificate of the identity provider and a single sign-on service.<br>Required when the external authentication does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-passphrase"></a>**passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase of [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key). Sent each time [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key) is. |
| <a id="parameter-private-key"></a>**private_key** | `str` | PEM private key of [`certificate`](#parameter-certificate). Use `""` to remove it.<br>The Bastion never returns it, so only whether it is set is compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the external authentication should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-timeout"></a>**timeout** | `float` | Timeout of the authentication, in seconds, between `1` and `900`.<br>The `timeout` field of the API. [`timeout`](#parameter-timeout) is the timeout of the requests to the Bastion.<br>Required when the external authentication does not exist yet and [`state=present`](#parameter-state). |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sends [`certificate`](#parameter-certificate), [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key) and [`passphrase`](#parameter-passphrase) only when the external authentication is created, or when one of them is set on one side only (set here and empty on the Bastion, or `""` here and set on the Bastion).<br>`always` sends the ones that are set on every run, which then always reports a change.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- The Bastion refuses to delete an external authentication that an authentication domain uses.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Declare a SAML identity provider
  wallix.bastion.externalauth_saml:
    authentication_name: corp-idp
    idp_metadata: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.url', 'https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml', split_lines=false) }}"
    timeout: 30
    claim_customization:
      username: uid
      email: mail
      group: memberOf
  register: idp

- name: Show the metadata to declare the Bastion on the identity provider
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ idp.externalauth.sp_metadata }}"

- name: Remove the SAML identity provider
  wallix.bastion.externalauth_saml:
    authentication_name: corp-idp
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated. Contains the secret options that were sent when [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password).<br><br>Returned: when the external authentication already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["claim_customization"]` |
| <a id="return-externalauth"></a>**externalauth** | `dict` | The external authentication as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without its private key.<br>Certificates are returned as their subject.<br>In check mode, the expected external authentication. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-externalauth) |

<a id="sample-externalauth"></a>

### Sample of `externalauth`

```yaml
authentication_name: corp-idp
certificate: ''
claim_customization:
  email: mail
  group: memberOf
  username: uid
description: ''
grouping_id: ''
id: 1a0f767d044e6138005056b66c8b
idp_entity_id: https://idp.example.com/saml
idp_metadata: <?xml version="1.0"?><md:EntityDescriptor ...>...</md:EntityDescriptor>
saml_request_method: HTTP-Redirect
saml_request_url: https://idp.example.com/saml/sso
sp_assertion_consumer_service: https://bastion.example.com/api/saml
sp_entity_id: https://bastion.example.com/api/saml/metadata
sp_metadata: <?xml version="1.0"?><md:EntityDescriptor ...>...</md:EntityDescriptor>
sp_single_logout_service: https://bastion.example.com/api/saml/logout
timeout: 30.0
type: SAML
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/externalauths/1a0f767d044e6138005056b66c8b
```
